note: Lakeland Provincial Recreation Area campground at Touchwood Lake, reached by Hwy 881, Township Rd 672 and a 30-km access road: an East loop (sites 1-29), a West loop (30-67) and a loop by the boat launch (68-88), all in forest behind the day-use beach. Pier, fish-cleaning station, playground; hand-pump water and firewood for sale mid-May to mid-September. An OHV staging area for the Lakeland trail network is just outside the campground. A blue-green algae advisory has been in effect on the lake since July 20, 2026. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (updated Sep 21, 2026), its advisories and the tear sheet: unserviced C$22 (C$16.50 seniors) first-come; season CHANGED year_round false (derived) -> Year-round (sites 68-88 only in winter); sites 93 (derived) -> 88 (page table says 20, see flag); potable water false -> true; dump confirmed. OHV staging next to the campground flagged. Phone 780-623-7189 suggested.
flags: OHV (drop candidate under the OHV rule): the page says 'Just outside of the campsite, there is a staging area for OHV use for the trail network throughout Lakeland Provincial Recreation Area.' That is OHV staging adjacent to the campground for a named trail network. The campground itself is a general lake campground (boat launch, beach, playground), so this is the reviewer's call between 'adjacent OHV staging' (drop) and 'general campground with an OHV side' (stay).

SITE COUNT: the page table says 'Unserviced 20', but the page's own fall advisory names loops 'East (#1-#29) & West (#30-67)' and 'Loop by the Boat Launch (#68 - #88)', and the tear sheet numbers 1-88. The table's 20 matches the 21 winter sites, not the campground. Written 88 (stored 93 was derived from old note prose).
SEASON: stored year_round false (derived) contradicted by 'Season: Year-round'; written year_round true with the winter-sites note.
WATER: stored potable_water false (derived) contradicted: 'Potable water is available from the hand pump at this site.' Written true.
PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 780-623-7189' (Lakeland District Office). Recommend 780-623-7189.

ADVISORIES: Blue-Green Algae, Touchwood Lake, effective July 20, 2026, until further notice (in the note, dated). Fall camping from Sep 8, 2026: loops East and West closed for the season, 68-88 open. The Seibert road warning and Pinehurst construction are other campgrounds.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): on Esri imagery (2024-08-15) the East loop's south end is ~40-80 m from the shore through forest; the boat-launch loop (68-88) sits behind the day-use area and beach. No open apron from a pad. Never upgraded.
PIN (54.86070,-111.43420): at the campground road junction between the loops, ~120 m from the page's directions point 54.859811,-111.432997 - OK.
